collection.scopeLabel: 8 Board Exam Questions across Physics, Chemistry, Math & Biology — Class 11–12

items.subject: Physics
items.body: Find the dimensions of $a/b$ in the equation $P = \frac{a - t^2}{bx}$, where $P$ is pressure, $x$ is distance and $t$ is time.

metadata.markingCriteria: 1 mark for dimension of a, 1 mark for dimension of b, 1 mark for final ratio.

items.subject: Physics
items.body: The position of an object moving along x-axis is given by $x = a + bt^2$ where $a = 8.5\text{ m}$, $b = 2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$ and $t$ is in seconds. What is its velocity at $t = 0\text{ s}$ and $t = 2.0\text{ s}$? What is average velocity between $t = 2.0\text{ s}$ and $t = 4.0\text{ s}$?

items.subject: Physics
items.body: A block of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is placed on an inclined plane making an angle of $30^\circ$ with the horizontal. If the coefficient of static friction $\mu_s = 0.7$, determine the frictional force exerted on the block.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: When electromagnetic radiation of wavelength $300\text{ nm}$ falls on the surface of sodium, electrons are emitted with a kinetic energy of $1.68 \times 10^5\text{ J mol}^{-1}$. What is the minimum energy needed to remove an electron from sodium? What is the maximum wavelength that will cause a photoelectron emission?

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: Calculate the EMF of the cell at $298\text{ K}$ for $\text{Mg}(s) | \text{Mg}^{2+}(0.001\text{ M}) || \text{Cu}^{2+}(0.0001\text{ M}) | \text{Cu}(s)$. Given $E^\circ(\text{Mg}^{2+}/\text{Mg}) = -2.37\text{ V}$ and $E^\circ(\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}) = +0.34\text{ V}$.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.body: Evaluate the definite integral: $\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}} \, dx$.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.body: Find the general solution of the differential equation: $\frac{dy}{dx} + y \cot x = 2x + x^2 \cot x \quad (x \neq 0)$.

items.subject: Biology
items.body: Describe the experiment conducted by Meselson and Stahl that proved DNA replicates semi-conservatively. Why did they use $^{15}\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}$?
